data.value: Bots log in and out over the day (fewest at night, most in the evening) instead of all being online 24/7.

data.name: BotConfiguration_MinOnlineSharePercent_Description
data.value: Percentage of the bot population which stays online at the quietest hour (100 = no rotation effect).

data.name: BotConfiguration_NumberOfAccounts_Description
data.value: How many bot accounts to maintain.

data.name: BotConfiguration_MaxCharactersPerAccount_Description
data.value: How many characters each bot account holds (max 5).

data.name: BotConfiguration_BotCapacityPercent_Description
data.value: Share of a game server's maximum player count which its bots may occupy; the rest stays reserved for real players.

data.name: BotConfiguration_BotsPayResetCosts_Description
data.value: If enabled, bots consume the configured zen/item costs for their resets like human players (default: free bot resets).

data.name: BotConfiguration_JewelStockPerKind_Description
data.value: How many Jewels of Bless/Soul/Life/Chaos a bot keeps of each kind; above this it stops picking them up and sells the surplus.

data.name: BotConfiguration_PotionStockCharges_Description
data.value: How many healing and mana potion charges a bot buys up to at a merchant.

data.name: BotConfiguration_MapsForbiddenForBots_Description
data.value: Maps bots never warp to: no hunting, following or events there, and a bot which logs in on one leaves it. Players are not affected.

data.name: BotConfiguration_ProofOfConceptAccounts_Description
data.value: Comma separated login names of existing accounts to animate as bots, in addition to the generated population.

data.name: BotSelfDefensePlugIn_Description
data.value: Makes server-side bots fight back when a player attacks them.

data.name: BotRevengePlugIn_Description
data.value: Makes server-side bots return to their death site and take revenge on the player who killed them.

data.name: BotSkillProgressionPlugIn_Description
data.value: Invests level-up stat points and teaches server-side bots new class- and level-appropriate skills as they level up.

data.name: BotFeaturePlugIn_Description
data.value: Spawns server-side bots which hunt monsters on the maps. Configure the accounts to animate and enable the feature.

data.name: MaximumConnectionsPerIpPlugIn_Description
data.value: Limits the maximum number of parallel connections from the same IP address.

data.name: LoginTimeoutPlugIn_Description
data.value: Disconnects clients which don't log in within the configured time after they connected.

data.name: SpeedHackDetectPlugIn_Description
data.value: Detects and prevents player walk and attack speedhacking.

data.name: KanturuGatewayPlugIn_Description
data.value: Handles the Kanturu Gateway Machine NPC for event entry.

data.name: SymbolOfKundunStackedPlugIn_Description
data.value: This plugin transforms a stack of symbol of kundun into a lost map.

data.name: DuelSpawnGatePlugIn_Description
data.value: Spawns a player which is in a duel at its side of the duel area.

data.name: SoccerSpawnGatePlugIn_Description
data.value: Spawns a player of a running soccer match on the soccer ground.

data.name: PetExperiencePlugIn_Description
data.value: Gives the trainable pets of a player a share of the experience which the player gained for a kill.

data.name: WhiteWizardInvasionPlugIn_Description
data.value: Enables the White Wizard Invasion feature.

data.name: ItemRegistrationConfiguration_Rules_Description
data.value: Configure item registration rules for different NPCs.

data.name: NpcItemRegistrationRule_NpcNumber_Description
data.value: The NPC definition number (e.g. 236 for Golden Archer).

data.name: NpcItemRegistrationRule_AcceptedItemGroup_Description
data.value: Group of the accepted item (e.g. 14 for event items).

data.name: NpcItemRegistrationRule_AcceptedItemNumber_Description
data.value: Number of the accepted item (e.g. 21 for Rena).

data.name: NpcItemRegistrationRule_RequiredItemsCount_Description
data.value: Number of items required to receive a reward.

data.name: NpcItemRegistrationRule_RewardZen_Description
data.value: Zen awarded upon reaching the required item count.

data.name: NpcItemRegistrationRule_RewardDropItemGroup_Description
data.value: The DropItemGroup used to generate the item reward drop. If empty, no item drops (Zen reward only).

data.name: PKClearConfiguration_ZenCostPerKill_Description
data.value: The amount of Zen required to clear one PK count.

data.name: PKClearConfiguration_AllowRegularPlayers_Description
data.value: Allows regular players to use this command to clear their own PK status for Zen.

data.name: LostMapDroppedPlugIn_Description
data.value: This plugin handles the drop of the lost map item. It creates the gate to the kalima map.

data.name: ItemBoxDroppedPlugIn_Description
data.value: This plugin handles the drop of an item box, e.g. box of kundun.

data.name: ActorHitRecorderPlugIn_Description
data.value: Records hits dealt and received by scripted test actors in their event stream.

data.name: SpeedHackDetectConfiguration_SkillHitCounterReplayWindowMs_Caption
data.value: Skill Hit Counter Replay Window Ms

data.name: SpeedHackDetectConfiguration_SkillHitMaxAreaToHitDelaySeconds_Caption
data.value: Skill Hit Max Area To Hit Delay Seconds

data.name: SpeedHackDetectConfiguration_AttackSpeedProfiles_Description
data.value: Optional overrides for individual skills. A profile replaces the common attack or magic speed settings for its skill.

data.name: AttackSpeedProfile_SpeedSource_Description
data.value: Which speed attribute scales the delay: Attack Speed for physical skills, Magic Speed for wizardry and curse skills.

data.name: RaklionPlugIn_Description
data.value: The event in the hatchery of raklion: when all spider eggs are destroyed, Selupan appears. After the battle, the hatchery is closed for some time.

data.name: CrywolfPlugIn_Description
data.value: The event in the crywolf fortress: the players defend the statue of the holy wolf against the army of Balgass. The result is kept until the next event.

data.name: CrywolfChatCommandPlugIn_Description
data.value: Lets the crywolf event proceed: it starts the event when it is not running, and during the battle Balgass appears if he did not yet. Otherwise, the current state ends.

data.name: ImperialGuardianFeaturePlugIn_Description
data.value: Configures the run of the imperial guardian event, e.g. its times, the experience reward and the scaling of the monsters.

data.name: SuspiciousScrapOfPaperStackedPlugIn_Name
data.value: Suspicious scrap of paper stack transformation

data.name: SuspiciousScrapOfPaperStackedPlugIn_Description
data.value: Transforms a full stack of suspicious scraps of paper into a Gaion's Order.

data.name: GensFeaturePlugIn_Description
data.value: Configures the gens system, in which the players can join one of the gens Duprian and Vanert at their npcs.

data.name: GensMembershipPlugIn_Description
data.value: Loads the gens membership of a character when it enters the game, and shows it to the player.

data.name: GensBattleZonePlugIn_Description
data.value: Only gens members can enter the battle zone. Kills between the members of different gens in it change their contribution points, without making the killer an outlaw.

data.name: GensRankingPlugIn_Description
data.value: Calculates the ranking of the gens in the configured interval, and updates the ranking positions and ranks of all members.

data.name: GensRelationshipRulesPlugIn_Description
data.value: The rules of the gens for parties, guilds and alliances: no party between different gens and in the battle zone, guilds and alliances only within a gens.

data.name: KalimaTicketConsumeHandlerPlugIn_Description
data.value: Opens a gate to the level of Kalima which fits the level of the character. Each use takes one of the ticket's usages.

data.name: KalimaTicketConsumeHandlerConfiguration_MinimumLevels_Name
data.value: Minimum levels of the Kalima levels

data.name: KalimaTicketConsumeHandlerConfiguration_SpecialCharacterMinimumLevels_Name
data.value: Minimum levels of the Kalima levels for special characters

data.name: BloodCastleArchangelTalkPlugIn_Description
data.value: Handles talking to the Archangel in the blood castle event, where players hand in the quest item to win the event.

data.name: IllusionTempleStoneStatueTalkPlugIn_Description
data.value: Handles talking to the Stone Statue in the illusion temple event, where players pick up the sacred relic.

data.name: IllusionTempleAllianceStorageTalkPlugIn_Description
data.value: Handles talking to the Alliance Item Storage in the illusion temple event, to which the allied forces carry the sacred relic to score a point.

data.name: IllusionTempleIllusionStorageTalkPlugIn_Description
data.value: Handles talking to the Illusion Item Storage in the illusion temple event, to which the illusion forces carry the sacred relic to score a point.

data.name: NpcTalkPlugInConfiguration_Npc_Description
data.value: The NPC which is handled by this plugin. If no NPC is set, the plugin doesn't handle any NPC.

data.name: TwisterAnimationCounterStrategy_Description
data.value: Describes how the game client counts the animations of Twister: every animation is counted, and the hits don't contain the animation counter.

data.name: EvilSpiritAnimationCounterStrategy_Description
data.value: Describes how the game client counts the animations of Evil Spirit: every animation is counted.

data.name: MultiShotAnimationCounterStrategy_Description
data.value: Describes how the game client counts the animations of Multi-Shot: the hits don't contain the animation counter.

data.name: LostConnectionDetectionPlugIn_Description
data.value: Disconnects players whose client stopped to report that it's alive, because their connection got lost without being closed. Otherwise, they would stay connected, and further logins of their account would be rejected.

data.name: LostConnectionDetectionConfiguration_Timeout_Description
data.value: The time after which a connection is considered lost, when its client didn't report that it's alive. The game client reports it every 20 seconds. Zero disables the detection.

data.name: CashShopVersionPlugIn_Description
data.value: Sends the versions of the cash shop script and banner to the player when it enters the game.

data.name: CashShopFeaturePlugIn_Description
data.value: The in-game cash shop. When it's deactivated, the cash shop can't be opened. Its configuration holds the settings, e.g. about gifts and the storage size.

data.name: GoblinPointsForPlayTimePlugIn_Description
data.value: Gives players Goblin Points of the cash shop for their play time.

data.name: VaultExtensionDeliveryPlugIn_Description
data.value: Extends the vault of the account when a player uses the Vault Expansion Certificate from the cash shop storage.

data.name: InventoryExtensionDeliveryPlugIn_Description
data.value: Adds an inventory extension to the character when a player uses the Magic Backpack from the cash shop storage.

data.name: SummonerCharacterCardDeliveryPlugIn_Description
data.value: Unlocks the Summoner class for the account when a player uses the Summoner Character Card from the cash shop storage.

data.name: RageFighterCharacterCardDeliveryPlugIn_Name
data.value: Cash shop: Rage Fighter Character Card

data.name: RageFighterCharacterCardDeliveryPlugIn_Description
data.value: Unlocks the Rage Fighter class for the account when a player uses the Rage Fighter Character Card from the cash shop storage.

data.name: GameEventPublisherPlugIn_Description
data.value: Publishes events of the game, like mini games, invasions, castle siege state changes and rare item drops, to the whole server, e.g. for a Discord integration.

data.name: GameEventPublisherConfiguration_PublishGlobalNotices_Name
data.value: Publish global notices of game masters

data.name: PlayerShopCurrenciesFeaturePlugIn_Description
data.value: Allows players to set the prices of the items in their personal store in configured items like jewels, or in account coins, too. Only the open source client shows these prices; with other clients, they can be set by chat command.

data.name: ShowShopCurrenciesAfterEnterWorldPlugIn_Name
data.value: Show player shop currencies after entering the game

data.name: ShowShopCurrenciesAfterEnterWorldPlugIn_Description
data.value: Tells the client which currencies can be used for the prices of personal stores, when the player enters the game.

data.name: ShopPriceChatCommandPlugIn_Description
data.value: Sets the price of an item of the own personal store in one of the enabled currencies, e.g. '/shopprice 1 10 bless'. Without arguments, it lists the prices.

data.name: ServerAnnouncementsPlugIn_Description
data.value: Shows a configured list of announcements to all players of a game server, one after another in a fixed interval.

data.name: ServerAnnouncementsConfiguration_Interval_Description
data.value: The time between one announcement and the next. The minimum is 10 seconds.

data.name: ServerAnnouncementsConfiguration_Messages_Description
data.value: The announcements, in the order in which they are shown. After the last one, it starts over with the first one.

data.name: ServerAnnouncementsConfiguration_Type_Description
data.value: How the announcement is shown, e.g. as golden message in the center of the screen or as blue system message.

data.name: CastleSiegeRegistrationGuardsmanTalkPlugIn_Description
data.value: Opens the Castle Siege registration window, which shows the Castle Siege status, when a player talks to a guardsman on the Castle Siege map.

data.name: CastleSiegeGuardsmanTalkPlugIn_Description
data.value: Shows Land of Trials availability and its applicable entry fee.

data.name: DiscordChatCommandPlugIn_Description
data.value: Links the account to a Discord user: '/discord link' creates a code which is entered in Discord, '/discord unlink' removes the link, '/discord notify letter' turns direct messages about letters on or off (also 'login' and 'friend').

data.name: WorldChatChatCommandPlugIn_Description
data.value: Sends a message to the world chat, which all players of all game servers can read, e.g. '/world Hello!'. It can be bridged to Discord.

data.name: GameEventPublisherConfiguration_PublishChatMessages_Name
data.value: Publish guild, alliance and world chat

data.name: GuildChatBridgeNoticePlugIn_Description
data.value: Tells players when they enter the game, if the chat of their guild or alliance is mirrored to Discord.

data.name: DiscordIntegrationFeaturePlugIn_Description
data.value: Tells game clients which ask for it how the server is connected to Discord (invite link, Rich Presence application, account link, mirrored chats), lets players link their account from the client, and sends them messages written in Discord as such.

data.name: EliteHealingPotionConsumeHandlerPlugIn_Description
data.value: Plugin which handles the elite healing potion consumption. It recovers the health immediately.

data.name: EliteManaPotionConsumeHandlerPlugIn_Description
data.value: Plugin which handles the elite mana potion consumption. It recovers the mana immediately.

data.name: EliteShieldPotionConsumeHandlerPlugIn_Description
data.value: Plugin which handles the elite SD potion consumption. It recovers the shield immediately.

data.name: MediumEliteHealingPotionConsumeHandlerPlugIn_Name
data.value: Medium Elite Healing Potion Consume Handler

data.name: MediumEliteHealingPotionConsumeHandlerPlugIn_Description
data.value: Plugin which handles the medium elite healing potion consumption. It recovers a part of the health immediately.

data.name: JewelOfExtensionConsumeHandlerPlugIn_Description
data.value: Repairs a lucky item to its full durability, if it isn't worn down completely.

data.name: JewelOfElevationConsumeHandlerPlugIn_Description
data.value: Gives a lucky item without a harmony option a harmony option.

data.name: LuckyItemWearPlugIn_Description
data.value: Equipped lucky items lose a point of durability each time they were worn for the configured interval.

data.name: ProgressionFeaturePlugIn_Description
data.value: How a world with the Season 21 maps progresses: the original Season 21 numbers, normalized into level 400 plus master level, or stars (resets) above the first band.

data.name: ProgressionConfiguration_MasterLevelCap_Name
data.value: Master level cap (empty: the mode's default)

data.name: ProgressionConfiguration_Season21ClassicWarpLevels_Name
data.value: Season 21 levels of the classic warps (warp index, level)

data.name: ProgressionConfiguration_Season21ClassicGateLevels_Name
data.value: Season 21 levels of the classic gates (gate number, level)

data.name: ProgressionConfiguration_EntryZenFlat_Name
data.value: Flat warp zen (empty: per entry level)

data.name: ProgressionConfiguration_OverCapStrengthPercent_Name
data.value: Strength of sets above power level 400 (%, normalized)

data.name: ProgressionConfiguration_EventBracketKey_Name
data.value: Event bracket level (empty: the mode's default)

data.name: ProgressionConfiguration_ItemLevelRequirementKey_Name
data.value: Item level requirement level (empty: the mode's default)

data.name: ProgressionConfiguration_StarRequiresMasterClass_Name
data.value: A star requires the third class

data.name: ProgressionConfiguration_StarFirstTierSize_Name
data.value: Stars of the first reward tier

data.name: ProgressionConfiguration_StarWorthFirstTier_Name
data.value: Power levels per star, first tier

data.name: ProgressionConfiguration_StarWorthSecondTier_Name
data.value: Power levels per star, after the first tier

data.name: ProgressionConfiguration_StarPointsFirstTier_Name
data.value: Levels' worth of stat points per star, first tier

data.name: ProgressionConfiguration_StarPointsSecondTier_Name
data.value: Levels' worth of stat points per star, after the first tier

data.name: ProgressionConfiguration_AttackSpeedLimit_Name
data.value: Attack and magic speed limit (empty = the database's, 0 = none)

data.name: ProgressionConfiguration_EnhancedMinimumMonsterLevel_Name
data.value: Lowest monster level for master experience from the total level 800 (0 = off)

data.name: ProgressionConfiguration_StarExperienceFloorPercent_Name
data.value: Lowest experience after the star penalty (%)

data.name: PartyExperienceBonusPlugIn_Description
data.value: The factor by which a party multiplies the experience of a kill, by its number of members and, for a party of different classes, a higher one.

data.name: EvolveChatCommandPlugIn_Description
data.value: Evolves a character into its next class: /evolve [character]. For game masters; the level rules of the fourth and fifth evolution don't apply.

data.name: Season21ItemsFeaturePlugIn_Description
data.value: The grade rates of the fourth and fifth wings and the mastery item mixes of the chaos goblin (Season 21 data).

data.name: EnhanceTreeFeaturePlugIn_Description
data.value: The skill enhancement tree of the fourth and fifth evolution: points from the levels above a Season 21 total of 800, read through the progression mode.

data.name: EnhanceTreeConfiguration_PointsStartAt_Name
data.value: Season 21 total level of the first point

data.name: EvolutionQuestFeaturePlugIn_Description
data.value: The trial of the 4th and 5th class quests: the town NPCs which take a character to the trial map, the monsters of each step and the kills of party members. Holds the experience of a 3rd class character at the level of the 4th evolution until it did the quest (setting).

data.name: EliteZonesFeaturePlugIn_Description
data.value: The five elemental elite zones of the maps from Scorched Canyon on. Their elites spawn inside them; a walk into a zone is refused when the character misses its entry rule.

data.name: FieldBossesFeaturePlugIn_Description
data.value: Medusa, Lord Silvester, Core Magriffy, Lord of Ferea, Nix and the God of Darkness with the shared random respawn, their stages and their arenas.

data.name: FieldBossConfiguration_ExitDelay_Name
data.value: Time until the arena is left

data.name: FieldBossChatCommandPlugIn_Description
data.value: Spawns a field boss now (/fieldboss nix); without a name it lists the bosses and their state.

data.name: ItemExpiryPlugIn_Description
data.value: Removes the expired items (timed items, rewards) from the inventory, the vault and the gremory cases of the players in the world.

data.name: GremoryCaseFeaturePlugIn_Description
data.value: The gremory case of Season 21: the character and account storage through which rewards are delivered, claimed into the inventory before they expire. Only for clients which show it; others get their rewards as before.

data.name: GremoryCaseConfiguration_MiniGameRewards_Name
data.value: Mini game item rewards go into the case

data.name: RuudFeaturePlugIn_Description
data.value: Ruud, the second currency of Season 21: the Ruud shop at its NPC (Priest James), the Ruud of killed monsters and of Ruud boxes.

data.name: RuudBoxConsumeHandlerPlugIn_Description
data.value: Opens a Ruud box: the character gets the Ruud which the configuration of the Ruud plugin sets for the box.

data.name: SetRuudChatCommandPlugIn_Description
data.value: Sets the Ruud of a character: /setruud <character> <amount>.

data.name: GetRuudChatCommandPlugIn_Description
data.value: Shows the Ruud of a character, the own without a name: /getruud [character].

data.name: LabyrinthChatCommandPlugIn_Description
data.value: Outside of the Labyrinth of Dimensions it enters a run without a ticket, at the given floor; inside, it clears the current floor and goes on with the given floor or the next one: /labyrinth [floor].

data.name: IllusionTempleLeagueChatCommandPlugIn_Description
data.value: Plays a stage of the Illusion Temple League on any day and opens its temples at once (elim, semi, final, reward); off gives the stages back to the days: /itleague <stage>.

data.name: SiegeChatCommandPlugIn_Description
data.value: Forces a state of the Castle Siege at its next tick (register, mark, notify, ready, start, end), or switches the crown test on or off (crown): it waives the two switches, so one attacker alone can capture the Crown.

data.name: GremoryGiftChatCommandPlugIn_Description
data.value: Puts an item into a gremory case: /gremgif <character> <case: 1 account, 2 character> <group> <number> [level].

data.name: ZenSinksFeaturePlugIn_Description
data.value: Against the zen inflation of the later maps: a tax on the zen sales of personal stores and less money from monsters, with the numbers of Season 21 as defaults.

data.name: LevelRewardsPlugIn_Description
data.value: A character which reaches a total level (level plus master level) of the list gets its item into the gremory case, or into the inventory when the case isn't available.

data.name: EventContributionPlugIn_Description
data.value: Kills and wins in the events (blood castle, chaos castle, devil square, illusion temple, imperial guardian, doppelganger) give points; at the end of the event the points give a Mastery Box into the gremory case, or into the inventory when the case isn't available.

data.name: EventContributionRule_SundayMonsterKillPoints_Name
data.value: Points of a killed monster on Sundays (0 for the same)

data.name: ElementsFeaturePlugIn_Description
data.value: The elemental damage and defense of Season 21: characters get their element from the pentagram and its errtels, monsters from their definition; the element wheel decides the multiplier.

data.name: EventContributionRule_RankPoints_Name
data.value: Points per rank (first entry is rank 1)

data.name: RadianceSlotScrollConsumeHandlerPlugIn_Description
data.value: Opens the fifth socket (radiance) of a pentagram with four sockets.

data.name: ElementsConfiguration_PentagramUpgradeRates_Name
data.value: Mastery pentagram upgrade rates by level (%)

data.name: ElementsConfiguration_ErrtelUpgradeRates_Name
data.value: Mastery errtel upgrade rates by level (%)

data.name: MuunFeaturePlugIn_Description
data.value: The Muun system: the Muun inventory with two equipped Muuns and their options on the owner, level up, evolution, the energy converter, the exchange NPC (Monica) and the mounts. Only the Babylon client shows it.

data.name: MuunConfiguration_EvolutionStoneNumber_Name
data.value: Item number of the evolution stone

data.name: MuunConfiguration_TempestEvolutionStoneNumber_Name
data.value: Item number of the tempest evolution stone

data.name: MuunConfiguration_EnergyConverterNumber_Name
data.value: Item number of the Muun energy converter

data.name: MuunConfiguration_WizardryStoneNumber_Name
data.value: Item number of the wizardry stone

data.name: MuunExchangeOffer_TargetNumber_Name
data.value: Muun of the evolution stone (item number)

data.name: MuunConfiguration_AttackSkillDamagePerLevel_Name
data.value: Damage of the attack skill per level

data.name: MuunConfiguration_HeroSlotLevel_Name
data.value: Total level of the hero slot

data.name: MuunConfiguration_HeroSlotHeroMuunsOnly_Name
data.value: Hero slot takes hero Muuns only

data.name: MiningFeaturePlugIn_Description
data.value: The mining spots of Season 21 in the safe zones of Lost Tower, Tarkan, Aida, Swamp of Calmness, Raklion and Kubera Mine: a character with a Pandora Pick mines them stage by stage for Jewels of Bless, may stop after each stage and loses the pending jewels when a stage fails.

data.name: MiningStage_ItemCount_Name
data.value: Items when stopping after the stage

data.name: HuntingRecordPlugIn_Description
data.value: Records per character, map and day the time spent, the monsters killed, the experience and the damage on the hunting maps of Season 21, and ranks the characters by total level and by the kills and experience of the week. The Babylon client shows both windows.

data.name: HuntingRecordConfiguration_SaveInterval_Name
data.value: Minimum time between writes of the state file

data.name: SoulConverterPlugIn_Description
data.value: A converter item of a tier, used by a character of its total level, draws soul missions; kills of their monsters absorb souls (shared in a party), and when all missions are done the player claims a reward of a kind the tier offers. Converters expire when the week starts again. The Babylon client shows the window.

data.name: SoulConverterConsumeHandlerPlugIn_Description
data.value: Activates the monster soul converter of the item, if the plugin Monster soul converter (Season 21) allows it, and uses the item up.

data.name: HelperPlusPlugIn_Description
data.value: Sends the rules of the helper to the Babylon client (the plus mode for characters of its total level, the ranges and the cost of the plus mode) and moves a character in the plus mode into the hunting zones of the hunting grounds, with the level and zen of the ground's warp.

data.name: HelperPlusConfiguration_PartyLeaderOnly_Name
data.value: Plus mode only alone or as party leader

data.name: Season21EventsFeaturePlugIn_Description
data.value: The definitions of the Season 21 events which run as mini games: Tormented Square, Labyrinth of Dimensions, Protector of Acheron and Boss Battle Together.

data.name: BossBattleDamagePlugIn_Description
data.value: Counts the damage of the players on the boss of the Boss Battle Together of Season 21.

data.name: TormentedSquareStartPlugIn_Description
data.value: Opens the Tormented Square of Season 21 by its timetable: fifteen rounds of monsters on map 102, ranked by points.

data.name: BossBattleStartPlugIn_Description
data.value: Opens the Boss Battle Together of Season 21 by its timetable: one boss on map 139 which everybody fights together.

data.name: AcheronGuardianStartPlugIn_Description
data.value: Opens the Protector of Acheron of Season 21 by its timetable: 30 waves of monsters in the event copies of Acheron and Deventer.

data.name: SeasonPassPlugIn_Description
data.value: The MU Pass of Season 21: missions give pass experience, the pass levels give the rewards of the free, gold and premium pass (buffs until the season ends, items into the gremory case); the seasons follow the schedule. The Babylon client shows the window.

data.name: SeasonPassConfiguration_TicketExperience_Name
data.value: Experience of an Exp Pass Ticket

data.name: SeasonPassTicketConsumeHandlerPlugIn_Description
data.value: Gives the season pass the experience of a ticket and uses the ticket up.

data.name: GoldPassTicketConsumeHandlerPlugIn_Description
data.value: Unlocks the gold pass of the running season and uses the ticket up.

data.name: PremiumPassTicketConsumeHandlerPlugIn_Description
data.value: Unlocks the premium pass of the running season for a character with the gold pass and uses the ticket up.

data.name: StatsSpecializationPlugIn_Description
data.value: A stat of a class raises attack power, attack or defense rates, defense, wizardry or curse damage by the percent of the section the stat is in, as the Season 21 data lists them. Off by default; the source gives no curve, so each section reads as: up to this stat, this percent.

data.name: LevelPenaltyPlugIn_Description
data.value: A character below a monster's level plus 600 deals 10 % less damage per level, takes 10 % more from it, and gets 10 % less experience in the Kardamahal temple, at most 70 % (S21Emu DamagePenalty.lua and ExperienciePenalty.lua). Levels map through the progression mode. Off by default.

data.name: LevelPenaltyConfiguration_MonsterLevelOffset_Name
data.value: Levels added to the monster level

data.name: LevelPenaltyConfiguration_DamageLevelMaps_Name
data.value: Maps with the damage penalty by total level

data.name: LabyrinthLeaguePlugIn_Description
data.value: The points, floor boxes and weekly leagues of the Labyrinth of Dimensions: groups of five characters per tier, promotion and demotion every week, the reward of the tier on the reward day (S21Emu LabyrinthOfDimension_League.xml).

data.name: ChaosCastleSurvivalPlugIn_Name
data.value: Chaos Castle Survival of the Fittest (Season 21)

data.name: ChaosCastleSurvivalPlugIn_Description
data.value: The monthly tournament of the Chaos Castle Survival on map 97: try-outs, semi-finals and the final by the day of the month, points for monster kills, player kills and the win, the best 20 of the try-outs and the best 10 of the semi-finals go on, the Conqueror's Badge for the champion.

data.name: ChaosCastleSurvivalStartPlugIn_Description
data.value: Opens the Chaos Castle Survival by its timetable on the days of the tournament; the final only at its own time.

data.name: LabyrinthRoomsPlugIn_Description
data.value: The 10 x 10 rooms of a floor of the Labyrinth of Dimensions: each room shows an area of another map, portals lead from room to room, mission rooms open their portals with their mission and the main mission clears the floor (S21Emu LabyrinthOfDimension_Path.xml). Only clients which draw the rooms play them; others play the floors without rooms.

data.name: ArcaWarPlugIn_Description
data.value: The guild war of Season 21 over three obelisks on Acheron and Deventer: guild masters register their guilds, then the members; during the war, a guild whose members stand on the three auras of an obelisk can destroy it and holds it; kills and obelisks give points for experience, and the guilds holding obelisks at the end get the buff of their elements and, in Acheron, more experience and item drops for a week (S21Emu Event/ArcaBattle.xml, webzen guide). A master pays 10 Signs of Lord to register; the damage between the guilds can be reduced; Sir Lesnar exchanges the Trophies of Battle. Only clients with the Arca War view (Babylon) can register.

data.name: AbilityCoreFeaturePlugIn_Description
data.value: The Ability Enhancement Core of the fifth evolution: skill, option, elite and extra damage cards in the slots of the core give their options and skills; the slots open with Season 21 total levels read through the progression mode. Cards level up with other cards, zen and stones, and reduce into stones. Only clients with the core view (Babylon) see the window.

data.name: AbilityCoreConfiguration_SkillSlotLevels_Name
data.value: Season 21 total level of each skill slot

data.name: AbilityCoreConfiguration_OptionRowLevels_Name
data.value: Season 21 total level of each option row

data.name: AbilityCoreConfiguration_RowsMatchColor_Name
data.value: A row takes only the cards of its color

data.name: UnderworldInvasionPlugIn_Description
data.value: The Death King and 110 Death Bones invade Lorencia or Noria.

data.name: SummonInvasionPlugIn_Description
data.value: Golden Goblins are summoned on Tarkan, Aida, Kanturu, Karutan or Acheron.

data.name: OwnMapRespawnPlugIn_Name
data.value: Respawn in the map's own safe zone

data.name: OwnMapRespawnPlugIn_Description
data.value: A character which dies on one of the listed maps respawns at the map's own spawn gate (the safe zone inside the hunting ground of Season 21) instead of its safezone map. Default: Kanturu Underground.

data.name: ArcaWarChatCommandPlugIn_Description
data.value: Handles the chat command '/arcawar'. Opens the registration of the Arca War, or ends its current stage, at the next tick.

data.name: IllusionTempleLeaguePlugIn_Description
data.value: The monthly guild tournament on the renewed Illusion Temple (maps 98 and 99): parties of one guild play the eliminations (3rd-9th), the best four the semi-finals (11th), their winners the final (12th); the players of the champion get the Wings of Conqueror from the reward day (13th).

data.name: IllusionTempleLeagueStartPlugIn_Description
data.value: Opens the temples of the Illusion Temple League by its timetable, on the days of the league.

data.name: IllusionTempleRenewalStatueTalkPlugIn_Description
data.value: Handles talking to the Cursed Statue (658), which gives the Cursed Hollow, and to the Captured Stone Statues (659-668), which seal or unseal it, in the renewed Illusion Temple.

data.name: ItemBagConsumeHandlerPlugIn_Description
data.value: Opens an item bag of Season 21: one item of every drop group of the bag lands next to the player, and the Ruud of the bag's row in the Season 21 item rules goes to the character. Needs the item rules of Season 21.

data.name: BlessingOfEuniceConsumeHandlerPlugIn_Description
data.value: Applies the Blessing of Eunice (more experience from monsters for a while) to a character of the fifth evolution.
